calibration_selection.initial_conditions: Published WT preset; any subsequent conditioning on native initial measurements must be recorded before freezing
calibration_selection.roles: Create a new explicit fit selection without rewriting original source row roles

evaluation_order: Complete native-only fitting, diagnostics, model selection and code review
Freeze training input hashes, configuration, prediction code and learned parameter payload in a write-once checkpoint
Only then introduce an unseen chemical task and its experimental input conditions to the generic evaluator
Seal predictions and their input/checkpoint hashes before outcome labels are supplied
Open outcome labels for scoring without refitting or excluding failed predictions

fitting_rules.downstream_product_information: Forbidden during training and model selection
fitting_rules.hplc_observation_gains: Fixed at one; no fitted concentration gain may hide synthesis or transport error
fitting_rules.identifiability: Report local sensitivity, search-bound proximity and effective degrees of freedom; collapse unsupported parameter directions rather than claim separate biological rates
fitting_rules.loss_scales: Derived only from native training measurements and recorded per observable
fitting_rules.parameterization: One positive multiplier per declared parameter group; members of a group share the multiplier
fitting_rules.protein_observation_gains: Positive scales estimated only from native training Westerns, separately for each declared protein observable

fixed_parameters.remaining_parameters: Published native-model priors unless a native-only identifiability study explicitly adds a supported parameter group before the checkpoint freeze

native_control_selection.use: Included as an additional native calibration protocol, not an independent holdout. Native-only development showed the joint shocked/control fit supports synthesis and diffusion estimation; the source OD driver and different culture initial conditions remain disclosed.

native_exchange_fit.censoring: Source zeros denote below-detection observations, not exact biological zeros; intervals with censored support remain unquantified
native_exchange_fit.inference_use: Quantified glucose and oxygen exchange curves provide native input-capacity scenarios; other readouts are retained as native diagnostics, not silently imposed as exact physiological bounds
native_exchange_fit.method: Piecewise-linear native exchange curves; no extrapolation and no invented detection limits

native_obligation_summary.summary: Temporal minimum and maximum of the fitted source carbon-commitment fraction within the native observation window; this span is not a statistical confidence interval
native_obligation_summary.uncertainty_policy: Preserve both native scenarios in generic inference; do not choose a favorable scenario using downstream measurements

native_obligations.absolute_flux_conversion: Requires justified volume/dry-mass data; no undocumented default
native_obligations.basis: Exact source reaction/compartment balances; distinguish de novo synthesis, inward transport, outward transport and net pool accumulation
native_obligations.fractional_alternative: A native carbon-commitment fraction may be transferred only after verifying a common source flux basis and linking it to actual utilized carbon, not merely its uptake bound
native_obligations.negative_or_infeasible_fluxes: No clipping, free-carbon remobilization or silent physiological bound relaxation
native_obligations.scope: Native obligations do not determine an unseen engineered pathway's realized allocation without additional evidence
native_obligations.water_volume: Use the source measurement-volume transform once and its analytic chain rule; do not reinterpret water-driven concentration changes as synthesis

parameter_selection.evidence_scope: Native-only preliminary fitting before any downstream task preparation
parameter_selection.uptake_decision: An additional uptake multiplier approached the lower search boundary and weakened sensitivity conditioning; retain the published uptake prior

prediction_contract.assessment: Report support, infeasibility, interval width and input-domain mismatch; a broad interval containing a label is not evidence of accurate titre prediction
prediction_contract.compartment_roles: Intracellular and extracellular compartment IDs are explicitly enumerated from the frozen host model, not inferred from an identifier spelling
prediction_contract.executable_code: Every evaluator and adapter dependency must match a code identity committed before task introduction; readout quantity and unit cannot change after freezing
prediction_contract.mass_basis: Base-host mass plus newly retained product; the envelope does not assign an unmeasured native glycerol-retention mass
prediction_contract.missing_kinetics_or_allocation: Return an identified feasible envelope or explicit lack of a point prediction, not an invented allocation fraction
prediction_contract.prediction_scope: Product-agnostic balanced-growth intracellular-content feasibility under learned native input and glycerol-commitment constraints, not realized titre allocation
prediction_contract.scope: A newly isolated training procedure is not a claim that the historical repository or its developers never encountered downstream products
prediction_contract.task_identity: No product-name switches or product-specific fitted constants; chemical stoichiometry and independently justified molecular constraints are explicit evaluation inputs
prediction_contract.uptake_limits: Use stoichiometry-weighted molecular net uptake constraints; preserve original hard exchange bounds. The native source model already has glucose-only carbon supply, so no medium opening is needed or authorized.

payload.purpose: Estimate native yeast glycerol synthesis and transport obligations without downstream product identities, pathways, measurements or fitted product constants.
